A short page with one picture

Short enough that the map is zoomed in far past the point where a text raster would read, so this page exercises the block renderer: the paragraphs above and below are text areas, the link is drawn in the page's own link colour, and the image is a hollow outline.

A section

Some more text, and a link worth seeing, so there is one of each kind of block on this page.

Lower down

Enough content below the picture that the page scrolls a little, so the viewport band has somewhere to move.

One last paragraph.
